correctness.rationale: Starting from the exact published centered tent-weight numerator, m=n+4 gives reciprocal coefficients c_(4+t)=Σ_A W_m(A)W_m(mt−4A) for −4≤t≤4. Direct finite quadratic sums in classes n=4h+1,4h+3 give five explicit cubic-in-h coefficients. The reciprocal transform Q(z)=z⁴F_n(z+z^(−1)) produces a quartic F with F(−2)=n+4>0, F(−3)<0, positive leading coefficient, so one root on (−∞,−3) and one in (−3,−2). The exact coefficients of F(−2−u) have signs +,−,−,+,+ (or a zero cubic at h=0), hence at most two positive roots by Descartes, proving those distinct simple roots exhaustive below −2. Positive coefficients exclude y>2; Deng–Fu unit-circle Fejér strict positivity excludes −2≤y≤2. The remaining reduced roots are conjugate nonreal; reciprocal quadratic lifting gives exactly four inside and four outside, no unit-circle or multiple roots. Independently reconstructed tent sums and reduced roots for odd n=1,3,5,7,9,11,17,31,43; source CHECK.py validates symbolic identities for all h. Tests alone do not replace the full analytic sign proof.
